changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7): NO + PLAY MODE and the KIT menu's RELOAD toggle between the kit as edited and the kit as saved; the first press stashes the edits, the next restores them.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
